text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling pollinator (bee) responses to two contrasting bioenergy land-use scenarios in Michigan, USA. While it uses land cover as an input variable and projects changes in bee metrics under hypothetical land-cover change scenarios, its primary objective is ecological—assessing impacts on pollinator abundance, diversity, and community composition—not predicting or simulating land use/land cover (LULC) change itself. The LULC scenarios are externally imposed assumptions (converting 600,000 ha of marginal land between grassland and annual crops), not outputs of a LULC prediction model. The study is regional (Lower Michigan), not national-scale, and does not meet the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation" or "primary focus = LULC prediction." It falls under species-specific/ecological focus related to land cover but not centered on LULC prediction, thus meeting exclusion criteria.)
